source.title: fix(indexd): make E2E bind address portable

focused_validation.observation: The test passed while port 8080 was already occupied; the helper preserved the foreign owner and indexd used an explicit free loopback port.

evidence: tests/test_push_index_e2e.py:99-105 selects a free TCP port
tests/test_push_index_e2e.py:123-129 propagates that port through base URL and INDEXD_BIND_ADDR
tests/test_push_index_e2e.py:158 asserts the selected base is not port 8080
tests/test_push_index_e2e.py:81-97 occupies port 8080 or preserves an existing foreign owner
tests/test_push_index_e2e.py:153-158 keeps port 8080 occupied during the E2E flow
focused validation passed with port 8080 already occupied
tests/test_push_index_e2e.py:108-117 terminates and escalates to kill only for the test-owned process
the context manager cleanup path executes after the deliberate cleanup sentinel
tests/test_push_index_e2e.py:65-77 polls /healthz to a bounded deadline
tests/test_push_index_e2e.py:138-141 waits for health before yielding the client base URL
GitHub code search returned no reference to tests/test_push_index_e2e.py outside the test file.
The eight checks reported for SemantAH PR #258 are CodeQL, context, drift and structure checks; none executes the focused E2E regression.

does_not_establish: that every SemantAH E2E test is port-independent
that future commits cannot regress the contract without checks failing
a required CI guard against reintroducing 127.0.0.1:8080

closeout_decision.reason: Kein verpflichtender SemantAH-Repository- oder GitHub-Check führt tests/test_push_index_e2e.py aus; damit ist das vierte Initiativen-Abschlusskriterium gegen Wiedereinführung der festen Portbindung nicht belegt.
closeout_decision.required_next_action: Den portablen Push-index-Regressionslauf in einen verpflichtenden SemantAH-CI-Pfad integrieren und einen erfolgreichen, revisionsgebundenen GitHub-Check nachweisen.
